tour_step_summary_desc: This bar shows your total income, expenses, savings, and yearly balance. Green means you're on track.
tour_step_sidebar_desc: Each card represents one month. A green border means the month is balanced (income − expenses − savings = 0).
tour_step_year_overview_desc: See all entries grouped by category across the whole year — useful for spotting patterns and annual totals.
tour_step_month_card_desc: Click a month to open its detail panel. You'll see the balance status and all entries for that month.
tour_step_month_header_desc: The header shows the month name, balance status, and the formula: income − expenses − savings. Aim for zero.
tour_step_entries_desc: Entries are grouped by type (income, expenses, savings) and category. Each section shows the total for that type.
tour_step_add_entry_desc: Click + to add a new entry. Choose the type (income, expense, or savings), the recurrence (monthly, one-time, or yearly ÷ 12), enter an amount, and assign a category.
tour_step_entry_actions_desc: Click ⋯ on any entry to open the actions menu: skip for this month, duplicate, or delete. Click the name to edit all details. Click the amount to override it for this month — for yearly ÷ 12 entries, the monthly amount is fixed and cannot be changed individually.
tour_step_settings_desc: Access categories, import/export your budget as JSON, switch theme or language, and replay this tour anytime.
